values.issue: “My September invoice disappeared after I changed plans.”
values.resolution: Invoices from an old plan only show under Billing history. Sent her the link and the PDF, and added the ticket to the known issue.

values.what-happened: A customer was charged twice and the refund needed a finance approval. The ticket passed the four-hour reply target while it waited.
values.lesson: Billing tickets that need finance should go to them in the first hour, not at the end of the day.

values.toughest-interaction: A customer who lost an afternoon’s work after a browser crash. Couldn’t get it back, but walked her through autosave so it won’t happen again.

values.top-issue: Invoices after a plan change: 9 tickets this week, up from 3.
values.staffing-gap: Monday morning. Half the week’s backlog arrives before 10:00 and only two of us start before then.
values.notes: The new help page on invoices went live on Thursday. Worth checking next week whether the tickets drop.
